metadata.description: mash: a mail mesh for Claude Code sessions

plugins.name: mash
plugins.description: Durable, signed mail between Claude Code sessions over NATS (SAP 0.3 + a mail verb), delivered by hook, with a channel as a one-line wake for an idle session.

plugins.name: mash-setup
plugins.description: Two skills: set mash up on this machine (binaries, a local NATS server, the mash plugin, first endpoints) and run it day to day. Install this one first.
